notes.title: Update Ver.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Changelog
Update released with new features and bug fixes.

Added Features
The following features have been added:

Story Expansion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/dbfd5ed9c18fb5c026a583af954bfab93292c82d.png
The story, which was limited to Chapter 2 in Early Access, is now fully playable to the end.

New Vehicles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/778e55eba1204fb1594241a0254df2f0615bd069.png
Added new cars, including models from Honda and LEXUS.

Aero Parts & Wheels
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/37a55179645cdfc845c324d9666ecbf23a4a5371.png
Some vehicles that did not have customization options in Early Access now support aero parts.
Additional wheel options have also been added.

Perk Tree Restrictions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/df63330c0f1241e4975501ca73abb5ab8a802e29.png
In Early Access, perk tree progression was restricted for difficulty balance.
Based on player feedback, we’ve added an option to remove these restrictions.
When starting a New Game, you can now choose whether restrictions are enabled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/84dbf95ff16ca6c8e8d0dfd20959a81dea32c447.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/6072960f45be72c980aae047bbe413e5512e9100.png
Save data carried over from Early Access will default to “Challenge” mode (restrictions enabled).
If you wish to remove restrictions, use the button at the bottom of the perk screen to switch to “Enjoy” mode.
※ Please note: This action cannot be undone.

B.A.D.NAME Editing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/d7949fd51400efabbf38c039d062c61074b200a8.png
While B.A.D.NAME is designed to assign names automatically based on your driving style,
we’ve added the ability to edit them using acquired words in answer to requests of
wanting to have the ability to decide your own name.
※ Names obtained prior to Ver.0.13.0 are not supported.

Rival Dialogue Reference
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/b27b59b05e378af171c7847e097ef93e55265ee7.png
Since certain rivals disappear as the story progresses, their dialogue can now be viewed in the reference screen.

New Perks
Added several new perks to assist with gameplay strategies.

Engine Swaps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/8235e1070e939e31a3aa19077f1335444ffaaff6.png
Vehicles that are weak in their stock form can now be made more competitive by replacing the power unit.

PA Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/fe7f72c9cbfb824d777100cb21f02774e49d3254.png
You can now request transport between PAs.

Tuner Summon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/d12738a83c9cb23507479fb356986b5e04c48e68.png
Legendary tuners can now be summoned to PAs where they are not normally present.

Aura System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/4c4e493cc3745ab21f57c9d58d010021f0939e5f.png
Although not a strategy element, acquired rival auras can now be equipped on your own vehicles.

NewGame+
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/d7ed8015eeec0f1e5f171cc3075371649710ace8.png
Defeating certain rivals late in the story will unlock “NewGame+” on the title screen.

This allows you to restart the story while retaining your CP and vehicles,
resetting story progress and the perk tree (perks will be refunded as BP).

Performance & Graphics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/c8504a57064582f32e74c90130e3dc75acd542fe.png
Added an option to lower the minimum frame rate from 60 to 30 FPS.

HDR Output Support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/186eb6bf892e909ea729c5ccc3baea13864ce09d.png
Added HDR output support. Enable HDR from the Options menu.
HDR screenshots can also be captured in Photo Mode when enabled.

Various Adjustments
We have made the following adjustments:

BP Adjustment
Adjusted BP rewards.

BP gained will now increase according to story progression.
Changed so that BP is awarded based on the driver level of your opponent.

    [tr]
        [th]Driver Level[/th]
        [th]First encounter[/th]
        [th]Subsequent encounters[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]1-5[/td]
        [td]5[/td]
        [td]1[/td]
    [/tr]

        [td]6-10[/td]

        [td]21-25[/td]

    [/tr]

        [td]6[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

SP Damage Revision
Revised the calculation formula for SP damage.
Since damage variation caused by parameter upgrades was too large, the overall fluctuation has been adjusted to be milder.

Collision Damage Revision
Revised the calculation formula for collision damage.
Reduced damage when driving at lower speeds in the early stage of a run.
Increased damage when driving at higher speeds later in a run.

Vehicle Behavior
Improved vehicle stability.
Expanded the suspension tuning range.

Vehicle AI
Adjusted rival behavior so that when the player takes the lead at course branches, rivals will follow more easily.

Bug Fixes
Have made the following fixes

Behavior

Fixed an issue related to water and oil temperature calculations.

Peripherals

Fixed issues that occurred with Logitech/Logicool steering wheel controllers.

UI

Fixed a minor bug related to cursor movement.

notes.title: Announcement of Full Release of “Tokyo Xtreme Racer”
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to all the players and fans for all the feedback and requests during the Early Access period.
The development team is excited to announce that “Tokyo Xtreme Racer” is now ready for its Full Release.
Throughout the Early Access period, we’ve received an incredible amount of feedback and requests from players around the world.
Your voices have been instrumental in shaping the game, and we are deeply grateful for your support.

Full Release Details
Release date: September 25, 2025 (JST)
SRP: $49.99 USD / 6,600 JPY

As previously announced, anyone who purchases during the Early Access period will be able to upgrade at no additional cost after the Full Release.
Please take this opportunity to consider purchasing the Early Access version.

What’s New in the Official Full Release
・Addition of new car models and car parts
・Addition of a new chapter and new rivals
・Game balancing and adjustments based on feedback from players

We would also like to provide some feature updates.

We have decided to postpone the implementation of the “Replay Feature” and prioritize additional game volume such as additional story content.
We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to this feature.
We will do our best to add the feature, polished and ready in future game updates.

After careful consideration, we have also decided not to implement “Steam Record Ranking” due to insufficient cheat prevention measures.
We believe introducing the feature without being able to provide a fair playing field for all players would negatively impact the player experience.

The passion, feedback and support from the fans has been invaluable to the development team.

We are very excited to finally deliver the complete experience and hope everyone will have a great time playing “Tokyo Xtreme Racer”.

notes.title: Update Ver.0.14.0
notes.notes:
Changelog
Update released with new features and bug fixes.

Added Features
The following features have been added:

PERK feature improvements
We've reviewed the Driver, Skill, and Perk categories, which were not often chosen as a way to spend BP, and made improvements to make them more appealing to players.

Driver
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/7506a53e3cd4c3018c7c5b02e078d8ab0bace487.png
The Driver category is a collection of items that improve driver abilities, broadly divided into two effects:

Improve Driver Ability
Unlock Driver Skills

Driver Abilities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/c66c2cb6d59a5999b980018ec4c1e742303fcb56.png
Starting with this version, Driver abilities have been revised and reorganized into the following five categories:

SP... Mental strength to continue the battle
ATK... Attack power that reduces the opponent's Mental strength
DEF... Defense power to protect against opponent's attacks
TGH... Durability to prevent Mental strength from being reduced due to collisions
TEC... Equippable Skill Slot

These abilities are permanently enhanced by unlocking them,
and the number unlocked is counted towards your driver level.

Driver Skills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/1eeddbc96a113950509adb1599345e264c029e3e.png
The "Skill" category, which represents Driver skills, has been merged into the "Driver" category and redesigned to allow skills to be unlocked according to ability level.

We've also systematically reorganized the categories, leaving only the items used in battles.
Skills will take effect when equipped on the GARAGE screen.

Perk
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/519f4ef5751957087787d07b913a7a79c7c2739f.png
In response to many requests for ways to efficiently earn CP, we've added features to make game progression easier, such as increased battle reward multipliers and discounts on part purchase prices.

These features have a higher cost to unlock, but once unlocked, their effects are permanent.

Obtaining BP
We've revised the way to obtain BP.

Previously, you could only obtain BP the first time you defeated a rival, now the BP is also obtained when battling and defeating a rival you have already defeated.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]EVENT[/th]
        [th]Obtained BP[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]1st win[/td]
        [td]+3[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]2nd win and after[/td]
        [td]+1[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Return of BP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/09da9c196b8d7b264b3f4726551bba5ec8f01838.png
Due to major changes to the PERK feature, it will no longer be possible to maintain your previous unlocked status.
When you restart the game, all PERK-related information in your save data will be reset,
and rewritten to an unlocked state.

The cost required to unlock Perk items has also changed.
To accommodate the new rules, BP obtained will be reverse-calculated based on Rival defeat information, allowing you to resume the game with all previously unlocked items.

Rival behavior improvements
We have also made as many improvements as possible to rival behavior, which was the most requested feature.

AI improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/4d2f9da8c17e9cb72073fe45c98b659b4d1cff7d.png
We've revised the AI programming to make it easier to give each rival their own unique personality.
We've added new rival personalities that were previously not fully expressible, such as blocking the player's line or intentionally slowing down.

Added Skills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/4cdabf468222a1a00752394dc928c6624bfbc675.png
To add variety to your battles, some rivals will now appear equipped with skills.
The skills of each rival can be checked on the REFERENCE screen.

UI improvements
Various bonuses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/f4c2a3f73245f197a04193f2cc475a46a51b66d7.png
With the PERK update, the rewards obtained after battle have also been revised to be displayed in more detail.

Skills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/c067ff84f1559d23d655ddde14fa22bb9632fd26.png
Since skills are now more of a focus than before, we've added skill display areas to several UI screens.

Various Adjustments
Various adjustments include:

Battles

Added a case where the next rival will appear in front during consecutive battles.
An alarm will now go off when SP is low.

Vehicle behavior

In line with the skill improvements, tire life has been doubled to allow for longer driving.
According to this change, wear reduction when oil and water temperature is enabled has been reduced from 1/4 to 1/2.
Revised boost pressure calculation for turbo vehicles.

Rivals

Adjusted the expressions of some rivals.

Other Cars

Driver level and tuning level will change as the scenario progresses.

Course entry screen

As the scenario progresses, unfulfilled goals that disappeared will now remain in a separate category.

Conversation screen

Changed the English font on the conversation screen.


Fixes
The following fixes have been made:

Vehicles

Fixed collision issues with Other Cars.
Fixed an issue where vinyl stickers would not stick properly on some vehicles.
Fixed an issue where the GRP logo would appear on some manufacturers' aero parts.

UI

Fixed a bug on the LIVERY screen.
Fixed a minor bug with cursor movement.

B.A.D.NAME

Fixed some issues with the conditions for obtaining B.A.D. NAMEs.

Achievements

Revised the description of ”Achievements”.

Translation

Fixed some translation issues.

notes.title: Update Ver.0.13.0
notes.notes:
Changelog
Update released with new features and bug fixes.

Added Features
The following features have been added:

Achievements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/7cfafbe067575643fdaa64295b73be554723d62d.png"]
It is now compatible with STEAM's achievement system.
Of the achievements planned for the full release version, those available in the Early Access version are displayed.

Additional Rules
Initially we decided not to implement it, but due to popular demand we created additional rules that allow you to control water and oil temperatures while driving.

When the additional rules are enabled, the water and oil temperatures will increase depending on the engine load.

If either of them reaches a certain temperature, the engine will go into safe mode to prevent breakdown.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/a6a7a16205f121441d70c2fb89f4572b1f8029c1.png"]
When the safe mode is activated, the engine speed, output torque, etc. are restricted and the vehicle will not be able to run at 100% performance.

In the UI, the red zone of the tachometer will be expanded and alert lamps on the water and oil temperature gauges will light up.
* Flashes as a warning.

Furthermore, if the additional rules are enabled, tire wear calculations will be performed constantly, meaning that durability will decrease even during free run.
*However, durability reduction rate will be suppressed to 1/4.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/b5ed5dd0b6282e8becd1af87b3293cb170036f73.png"]
With the additional rules enabled, the rewards for defeating rivals are increased by 1.5 times, as you will need to manage these factors while driving.

The additional rules serves as a challenge element. So players who want to increase the difficulty, please try it out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/99c487318fb212f6f915f6350474ddedf3b2cf12.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/92d605ad69c02d4c00a7fb9d785bdfabacc0e1fd.png
The additional rules can be enabled via a button on the GARAGE screen.

UI
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/9b4ec169603fc0ef2494ef0a47938938d616f994.png"]
The UI layout while driving has been revised with the addition of water and oil temperature gauges.

1. Water and oil temperature gauges
"Added water and oil temperature gauges above the tachometer.
Only visible when Water/Oil Temperature mode is enabled."

2. ODO/TRIP meter
In response to requests to be able to check the mileage while driving, an Odometer and a Tripmeter have been added.

3. Nitro Gauge
The size on the screen has become smaller, the available amount and effect remain the same.

4. Slipstream
The effect of slipstream is now clearly visible.

5. Input Value
Added an on-screen indicator that shows the amount of value being sent from the input device.

6. CP and BP
You can now check not only your current CP but also your BP.

Team Defeat
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/27a0fa9fc0f713d0678cd3edb4dd795180dfcacf.png"]
Added a visual to help make it clearer that the rival team has been defeated.

Option
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/af6cd5fd650f0cc1cefa1c93e0a5e8151b637fb0.png"]
On OPTION screen, each UI item could choose whether to display or hide during a race.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/5ab0a096ec1c6ecded70f5b3b05c9b276e5ef0fa.png"]
The gauge layout has also become selectable.

Race
Bonus
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/0cffc3755252a3cd74c1e94344d38bf480c71f5d.png"]
A bonus has been added when preventing an overtaking attempt by a rival.

Shift-up Alert
If the gear shift is manual, a warning sound will go off when it is time to upshift.

Sky Patterns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/ed0d416fed986c1fa77c2c287e9ef39afd21bb5d.png
The background changes randomly to reflect the daily sky patterns.
*However, there will be no changes to the road surface due to the background weather.

License Plate
The following names have been added:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/cd9afc3b7c3ac0e1be9649874f92da1a86606012.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/cf0d4709c870f2f2672ddd925ba35bcda4564cda.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/65eed3ea666fc7c8a6f12cfda6e6a5c3f2c73c26.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/021b343f4eb0b8a4988ca3c73f2a8b2fad5b3d98.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/5f59c2a2456005ef4e6c2df6fd3eab903feacc28.png"]

Language
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/d438f9ae05f72c1d4822ef17f14c02871c615676.png"]
Added Traditional Chinese character to the language switcher.

Various Adjustments
Various adjustments include:

Rivals

The positions of your car and rival's cars at the start of a battle have been revised.

If you initiate a battle on the course, you will start the battle behind the rival's car.
If a rival initiates a battle on the course, the battle will start in front of the rival car.
If you challenge a battle at PA, the battle will start in line.

Vehicles

The center of gravity of vehicles with horizontally-opposed engines has been lowered slightly.

Vehicle AI

Adjusted the rivals to make it harder for them to collide with other vehicles in corners.

PA

Adjusted the battle start positions of Tatsumi PA and Daikoku PA to be parallel.

Option

Battle BGM start timing has become selectable.
Force feedback strength can now be increased up to 5 times.
Feedback strength changes correspond to each type of feedback.


Fixed
The following fixes have been made:

Vehicles

Fixed some bugs with some vehicle models.

Vehicle AI

Fixed an issue where it was not possible to direct rivals at certain forks in the course.
Fixed an issue where some Other Cars would hit walls while turning corners.

Rivals

Fixed an issue where more rivals than intended would appear on the course.

Course

Fixed some bugs in the course model.

Photo Mode

Fixed an issue where screenshots taken under certain conditions on Steam Deck were not saved to a folder.
Fixed a bug that caused sounds to stop playing before and after Photo Mode.
Other minor bugs have been fixed.

UI

Fixed minor issues with the DEALER screen.
Fixed a minor bug on the COLLECTION screen.
Fixed minor issues with the TUNE screen.
Fixed a minor bug on the AERO screen.
Fixed a minor issue with the LIVERY screen.
Fixed a minor bug on the MAP screen.
Fixed minor issues with the PERK screen.
Corrected mistranslated text on some screens.

B.A.D.NAME

Fixed an issue where some B.A.D.NAMEs could not be acquired.

The warning popup has been improved to be more noticeable.
Some button icons have been revised.
Some wording has been revised.

Fixes

Fixed an issue of getting damage from the rivals with zero SP, when battling multiple rivals.
Fixed a bug with the HUD display during battle.
Fixed some vehicle model issues.
Fixed some bugs on the license plate selection screen.

"り" can now be selected for private cars.
"よ" can now be selected for kei cars.

Corrected the limit for "Classification Number".

notes.title: Photo Mode Update Ver.0.11.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/dd670e13838230e64c44798bd0dc64e0e5107009.png

Added Features
The following features have been added:

Photo Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/cb15bd6ccd477c61f10f219997eaca3326ea10ae.png
Photo mode has been added by popular demand.
Photo mode can be used for taking pictures in the garage, in the reference screen, on the in-game course, and in PAs.

Logo Sticker
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/3f23461dfa73dc473a7ad152677daf2a03354bca.png
After a long time of preparation,  now the sticker feature within Livery becomes available.
It is now possible to put logo stickers on windows, in accordance with the regulations of each manufacturer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/e2a76daa89810c7eeb9402d4730af25aaffd4a60.png
Vinyl now has a feature that allows you to cut out a part of a design from a rival vehicle and stick it on your own car.

Stretch Tires
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/1ea4dd35a5a5932ffd3c7c131495b39f2c514932.png
A UI has been added that allows you to use the stretch tire effect  that was previously applied to some rival cars only.
You will be able to adjust the tire width to the wheel rim width.
※There is no effect on the vehicle behavior.

The following settings will allow you to create stretch tires:
1. On the Tune screen, tune the tires to level 1 or higher.
2. Change the tire width on the settings screen.

Silhouette
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/6bb9db373681833f95a1208770d3eb712c99b1d0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160965/1e7319fcb83bb7831c765ad9303577422a26b8af.png

Regarding clutch operation.

Vehicle Model

Adjusted the appearance of some rival vehicles.


Fixes
The following fixes have been made:

Fixed an issue where nearby rivals would change position when entering PA.
Fixed some bugs with some vehicle models.
Fixed some UI bugs.
Fixed some translation issues.
Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update Ver.0.10.4
notes.notes:
Changelog
Adjustments
The following adjustments have been made:

Increased the display time of CP earned after defeating a rival from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.
Adjusted the BGM of battles to play after the countdown.
The appearance of some rival vehicles has been adjusted.
The appearance of some courses has been adjusted.

Fixed
The following fixes have been made:

Fixed a bug that caused a one-sided decrease in SP on the rival's side when contacting a rival vehicle.
Fixed a bug in which opening Help during a PA battle conversation would cancel the conversation.
Fixed a problem in which joints were not processed in some sections of the course.
Fixed a bug that would cause an other car to be launched from an unintended location near the confluence point of the course.
Fixed a problem in which the system menu could be opened when it should not.
Fixed a problem in which the UI would stop responding after certain operations on certain screens.
Fixed a problem in which the UI at the bottom of the perk screen would not respond on a 4K display.
The problem has been mitigated where the neon lights would not be visible when the vehicle height was lowered.
Fixed a glitch in which the GRP logo was displayed on some manufacturers' aero systems.
Fixed a problem in which the matte parameter of the vinyl was not applied correctly.
Bugs with some vehicle models have been fixed.
Other minor bugs in the UI have been fixed.

notes.title: Update Ver.0.10.3
notes.notes:
Changelog	
Added
The following features have been added:

Added a feature to show the direction the Rivals are heading at course splits.
Added a feature to drop out of a battle by holding down the hazard lights button.
Added the ability to change views during autopilot.
RGB values can now be edited with a slider bar when selecting "Other Colors".
Additional UI display have been added.

Added an indicator to show that owned CP would exceed the limit after selling an item.
Added an indicator to show the amount of CP spent in PAs in the Garage Results.


Balance Adjustment
The following balance adjustments have been made:

The game balance has been adjusted.

Reviewed when Tuning is unlocked in the perk screen.
Reviewed Rival strength in accordance with the adjustment of when Tuning is unlocked.

Adjusted the effect of ABS.
Reviewed the available setting items when the suspension level is upgraded.

Other adjustments
Other adjustments include:

Reviewed the default settings when a controller is connected.

Initial value of “Parking Brake Reaction Time” is set to 0.

Poems videos are now skipped by holding down the confirm button.
The appearance of some rival vehicles has been adjusted.
Adjustments have been made to the appearance of some of the courses.

Fixed
The following fixes have been made:

Fixed a bug with Copen (LA400K) where it would not upshift when AT mode is used.
Fixed a bug where some B.A.D names could not be unlocked when specific team emblems were part of the unlock condition.
Fixed a bug in which tire performance was restored when driving in reverse during a battle.
Fixed a bug that prevented the vehicle from shifting out of neutral gear when engaging Autopilot mode in MT mode.
Fixed a bug where performance could decrease with tunes from the legendary tuner.
Mitigated the bug that caused Rivals to spawn in the same position at the beginning of a battle.
Fixed a bug that affected 3D sound positioning in certain PC setups.
Fixed graphical glitches with the wheels on some vehicles.
Fixed graphical glitches on some vehicles.
Fixed graphical glitches that were occurring in some PAs.
Fixed a glitch in which the GRP logo was displayed on some manufacturers' aero parts.
Fixed some UI bugs.
Fixed some localization issues.
Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update Ver.0.10.2
notes.notes:
Changelog	
Added
		The following features have been added.
		
		The name of the rival's vehicle in battle is now displayed.
		Added display to indicate that the car is on autopilot.
		Gear shift (auto/manual) can now be toggled from the ingame options.
		Added the option to allow rear-view mirror display in the hood camera.
		Added the option to adjust the camera vibration while driving at high speeds.
		The map screen and perk screen will now scroll when the cursor is moved to the edge of the screen.
		A thumbnail for the selected vehicle is now displayed on the perk screen (the machine tab).
		
Changed
		The following adjustments have been made.
		
		Adjustments have been made regarding the rival MELANCHOLIC ANGEL.
		  Adjusted to be slightly weaker when she appears in the scenario.
		  The current strength is maintained when she reappears after being defeated.
		  The conditions under which the custom car GLOOMY ANGEL can be purchased have been changed to "After MELANCHOLIC ANGEL has been defeated a second time".
		Reviewed the AI of some Rivals.
		Adjusted upshift timing when gear shift is set to auto.
		Initial settings when connecting a steering wheel controller have been revised.
		  Initial value of “Steering Angle Correction” is set to off.
		  Initial value of “Handling Response Time” is set to 0.
		  Initial value of “Handling Return Time” is set to 0.
		  Initial value of “Acceleration Return Time” is set to 0.
		  Initial value of “Braking Return Time” is set to 0.
		Adjusted the number of other cars that appear on different days of the week.
		The volume of the opening movie has been reduced.
		The appearance of some Rival vehicles have been adjusted.
		
Fixed	
		The following fixes have been made.
		
		Fixed a crash that could occur when unplugging and plugging in the controller.
		Fixed a bug that caused slow motion depending on the combination of graphics settings.
		Frame drops when passing over joints have been reduced.
		Names of some characters have been changed.
		Some localization issues have been fixed.
		Fixed a display bug that had been occurring in some vehicles.
		Fixed a bug with the number plate that was occurring for some rivals.
		Fixed a bug of being able to race some of the Wanderers without meeting requirements.
		Fixed a bug in the process of determining the drift bonus.
		Made a fix so that if the player continues to fall off the course, they are returned to the garage.
		Fixed a bug causing brake rotors turning too red.
		In the guide UI displayed when the road splits, the PA display is now blocked during battles.
		Fixed a bug that occurred when the legendary tuner enhanced a vehicle in Normal state.
		Fixed the area that determines the PA entrance.
		Fixed an issue where other cars would spawn on top of the player's car at the start of a PA battle.
		Fixed an issue where the vehicle in the garage was duplicated.
		Fixed a bug where custom cars could be purchased multiple times.
		Fixed a bug with the UI.
